Name: Unofficial gap-be-gone fix for Portrait Frame Variations
Author: CheeseKayke
Description:
[center]My own fix for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899?tab=description]Portrait Frame Variations[/url] mod to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]﻿[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]﻿Changing Skies[/url]﻿ new gapless version until the original author is able to make a fix~

[img]https://i.imgur.com/urxJZcS.png[/img]
﻿
Simply replace the files in the [b]PortraitFrames_ChangingSkies [/b]folder with my files.

I wasn't able to test all the frames, so please let me know if I missed anything or if anything looks a little strange and I'll make an edit!
This is my first time making a fix like this so some added textures may look a little odd and i'd be more than happy to fix it if asked~!
